title: Provider credentials
description: Payment-provider merchants, smart-lock vendor accounts and e-Tax accounts per tenant, and the platform's own merchant. Values are sealed with the tenant's data key and never shown (D-240).
platformHint: Every tenant's credentials and the platform merchant's. A tenant's credentials are set on its page; the platform merchant's here.
tenantHint: This tenant's payment merchants, lock vendor accounts and e-Tax account. Values are write-only.

revokeBody.payment: The provider adapter has no credential for this merchant afterwards: new QR codes and payment checks of this account fail until a new credential is set. Revoke a leaked key at once, then set the new one.
revokeBody.lock: The lock vendor adapter has no credential for this account afterwards: lock syncs and door codes through the vendor fail until a new credential is set.
revokeBody.etax: The e-Tax adapter has no credential for this account afterwards: submissions to the provider fail until a new credential is set.

emptyHint: Set one before the tenant's QR payments, lock syncs or e-Tax submissions go live.
auditBody: Values are never returned or shown again — not even to you after saving. Every set, rotation and revocation is in the audit log with key names and a fingerprint, never values; every use of a credential by a provider adapter is audited too (provider_credential.decrypted). The fingerprint changes whenever the values change and reveals nothing about them.
writeOnlyBody: They are sealed when you save and never shown again. Paste them from the provider's portal; this browser is asked not to remember them.

form.title: Set a provider credential
form.hint: A credential for the same account replaces the live one, which is revoked in the same step.
form.stored: Credential saved — fingerprint {fingerprint}. The values are not shown again.
form.merchantRefHint: The merchant reference at the provider (the tenant bank account's provider reference). Only its last 4 characters are kept visible.
form.merchantRefRotate: Type the merchant reference again — it ends with …{hint}.
form.valuesHint: The key names the provider's adapter reads are filled in; rename, add or remove keys if the provider's portal differs.
form.reasonHint: 3–500 characters, e.g. the ticket. Stored in the audit log.

problem.noKeys: Enter at least one key and value.
problem.keyName: Key names start with a letter and use letters, digits and _ only (at most 64).
problem.valueTooLong: A value has at most 4,096 characters.

form.replacesBody: The current credential of this account is revoked when the new one is saved; the adapter uses the new values from the next call.
